title: Resolution of Singularities in Positive Characteristic
description: Every algebraic variety over a field of positive characteristic has a desingularization.

title: Abundance Conjecture
description: The canonical bundle of a minimal projective variety is semiample.

title: Standard Conjectures on Algebraic Cycles
description: Intersection behaviors of algebraic cycles on smooth projective varieties are well behaved.

title: Section Conjecture
description: Rational points on curves correspond to sections of fundamental group extensions.

title: Homological Mirror Symmetry
description: Derived categories of coherent sheaves are equivalent to Fukaya categories.

title: Yau-Tian-Donaldson Conjecture
description: Existence of Kahler-Einstein metrics equates to K-stability of Fano manifolds.

title: Hopf Conjecture
description: Compact Riemannian manifolds with positive sectional curvature have positive Euler characteristic.

title: Chern Conjecture
description: The Euler characteristic of a compact affine manifold is zero.

title: Willmore Conjecture
description: The Clifford torus minimizes the Willmore energy among all smooth tori.

title: Lawson Conjecture
description: The Clifford torus is the only minimally embedded torus in the 3-sphere.

title: Iitaka Conjecture
description: The Kodaira dimension of a fiber space is superadditive over its base.

title: Campana Conjecture
description: Special varieties are exactly the varieties with potentially dense rational points.

title: Fujita Conjecture
description: Adjoint bundles of ample line bundles are globally generated for large multipliers.

title: SYZ Conjecture
description: Mirror symmetry arises from dual special Lagrangian torus fibrations.

title: Generalized Smale Conjecture
description: Diffeomorphism groups of spherical space forms retract to their isometry groups.

title: Caratheodory Conjecture
description: Every closed convex surface has at least two umbilic points.

title: Vafa Conjecture
description: Massless states in string theory correspond to topological invariants of Calabi-Yau manifolds.

title: Green Conjecture
description: Relates the Clifford index of a curve to its canonical syzygies.

title: Griffiths Conjecture
description: Positive vector bundles on Kahler manifolds admit metrics with positive curvature.

title: Franchetta Conjecture
description: The universal curve Picard group is generated by the canonical class.

title: Gieseker Conjecture
description: Classifies stable vector bundles on algebraic surfaces using characteristic classes.

title: Virasoro Conjecture
description: Gromov-Witten invariants of projective manifolds satisfy continuous Virasoro algebra constraints.

title: Faber Intersection-Theoretic Conjecture
description: Describes the tautological ring structure of the moduli space of curves.

title: Shafarevich Conjecture on Holomorphic Convexity
description: The universal cover of a compact Kahler manifold is holomorphically convex.

title: Andre-Oort Conjecture
description: Subvarieties containing dense sets of special points in Shimura varieties are special.

title: Ax-Schanuel Conjecture
description: A functional transcendence statement bounding intersections of algebraic and exponential varieties.

title: Borisov-Alexeev-Borisov Conjecture
description: Fano varieties with epsilon kawamata log terminal singularities form bounded families.

title: Minimal Model Program
description: Every complex projective variety is birational to a minimal or Fano model.

title: Sarnak Conjecture
description: The Mobius function is disjoint from all sequences of zero topological entropy.

title: Lang Conjecture
description: Hyperbolic complex projective varieties lack rational and elliptic subvarieties.

title: Green-Griffiths Conjecture
description: Entire holomorphic curves in general type varieties are degenerate.

title: Kobayashi Conjecture
description: A generic hypersurface of high degree in projective space is Kobayashi hyperbolic.

title: Demailly Conjecture
description: Provides a sufficient condition for a projective variety to be Kobayashi hyperbolic.

title: BCOV Conjecture
description: Relates Gromov-Witten invariants of Calabi-Yau manifolds to analytic torsions.

title: Crepant Resolution Conjecture
description: Equates quantum cohomology of an orbifold to that of its crepant resolution.

title: Ruan Conjecture
description: Cohomology rings of crepant resolutions match stringy cohomology rings of orbifolds.

title: Arnold Conjecture
description: Fixed points of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms are bounded by Betti numbers.

title: Weinstein Conjecture
description: Every Reeb vector field on a compact contact manifold has closed orbits.

title: Hofer Conjecture
description: The Hofer metric on the group of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms is strictly intrinsic.

title: Viterbo Conjecture
description: The volume of convex bodies bounds their symplectic capacities.

title: Penrose Inequality
description: Spacetime mass is bounded below by the area of its event horizons.

title: Generalized Calabi Conjecture
description: Existence of extremal Kahler metrics is equivalent to relative K-stability.

title: S-Duality Conjecture
description: Strong coupling in one string theory corresponds to weak coupling in another.

title: Geometric Langlands Conjecture
description: Equates D-modules on the moduli space of bundles to Galois representations.

title: P=W Conjecture
description: The perverse filtration matches the weight filtration on character varieties.

title: Betti Langlands Conjecture
description: A topological version of the Langlands correspondence for character varieties.

title: Atiyah-Floer Conjecture
description: Instanton Floer homology is isomorphic to Lagrangian intersection Floer homology.

title: Witten Conjecture
description: Intersection numbers of tautological classes on moduli spaces satisfy KdV equations.

title: Kuga Conjecture
description: Certain Hodge cycles on abelian varieties are absolute Hodge classes.

title: Bass-Quillen Conjecture
description: Finitely generated projective modules over polynomial rings of regular rings are free.

title: Parshin Conjecture
description: Higher algebraic K-groups of smooth projective varieties over finite fields vanish rationally.

title: Beilinson Conjectures
description: Relates special values of L-functions to regulators in algebraic K-theory.

title: Soule Conjecture
description: Certain algebraic K-groups of the integers vanish identically.

title: Lichtenbaum Conjecture
description: Relates special values of zeta functions to étale cohomology of arithmetic schemes.

title: Grothendieck-Serre Conjecture
description: Principal bundles for reductive algebraic groups are trivial over regular local rings.

title: Busemann-Petty Problem
description: Do symmetric convex bodies with larger hyperplane sections have larger volume?

title: Mahler Conjecture
description: The Mahler volume of symmetric convex bodies has a positive lower bound.

title: Viro Conjecture
description: Limits the topological types of real algebraic hypersurfaces of given degrees.

title: Ragsdale Conjecture
description: Bounds the number of components of real algebraic curves by degree.

title: Gudkov Conjecture
description: Relates the arrangement of ovals of real algebraic curves to congruences.

title: Thom Conjecture
description: Algebraic curves minimize genus among smoothly embedded surfaces representing the same homology.

title: Milnor Conjecture
description: Milnor K-theory modulo two is isomorphic to étale cohomology with coefficients.

title: Hsiang-Lawson Conjecture
description: The Clifford torus minimizes area among equatorial tori in the 3-sphere.

title: Berger Conjecture
description: Riemannian manifolds with reduced holonomy are locally symmetric or locally irreducible.

title: Osserman Conjecture
description: Riemannian manifolds with constant eigenvalue spectra for Jacobi operators are locally symmetric.

title: Yau Conjecture
description: The first eigenvalue of closed minimal surfaces is related to its area.

title: Schoen-Yau Conjecture
description: A metric of positive scalar curvature exists on any manifold without tori.

title: Eells-Sampson Conjecture
description: Existence of harmonic maps with specific properties between compact Riemannian manifolds.

title: Lichnerowicz Conjecture
description: Harmonic manifolds are locally symmetric spaces or flat manifolds.

title: Obata Conjecture
description: Riemannian manifolds with specific conformal vector fields are isometric to spheres.

title: Llarull Conjecture
description: Bounds the scalar curvature of Riemannian manifolds using degree theory.

title: Gromov Conjecture
description: Relates the scalar curvature of a manifold to its simplicial volume.

title: Rosenberg Conjecture
description: Existence of positive scalar curvature metrics connects to analytic index theorems.

title: Bando-Mabuchi-Mukai Conjecture
description: Kahler-Einstein metrics exist on Fano manifolds with reductive automorphism groups.

title: Hamilton-Tian Conjecture
description: Kahler-Ricci flow on Fano manifolds converges to Kahler-Ricci solitons.

title: Thurston Geometrization Conjecture
description: Every closed three-dimensional manifold decomposes into pieces with uniform geometric structures.

title: Smale Conjecture
description: The diffeomorphism group of the three-sphere retracts to its orthogonal group.

title: Rokhlin Conjecture
description: Every smooth homology 3-sphere bounds a contractible smooth four-manifold.

title: Casson Invariant Conjecture
description: The Casson invariant distinguishes certain classes of smooth topological manifolds.

title: Bounded Negativity Conjecture
description: The self-intersection of irreducible curves on algebraic surfaces is bounded below.

title: SHGH Conjecture
description: Calculates dimensions of linear systems of plane curves with assigned basepoints.

title: Nagata Conjecture
description: Bounds the minimal degree of a plane curve through general points.

title: Nagata-Biran Conjecture
description: Predicts ample bundles on blowups of surfaces at points.

title: Terao Conjecture
description: Freeness of hyperplane arrangements is determined by their intersection lattices.

title: Orlik-Solomon Conjecture
description: Relates intersection lattices of arrangements to their fundamental groups.

title: Goresky-MacPherson Conjecture
description: Intersection homology determines topological invariance for certain classes of singular spaces.

title: MNOP Conjecture
description: Gromov-Witten and Donaldson-Thomas invariants of Calabi-Yau threefolds are equivalent.

title: Ooguri-Vafa Conjecture
description: Integrality of certain invariants defined via topological strings on Calabi-Yau threefolds.

title: Katz-Klemm-Vafa Conjecture
description: Gromov-Witten invariants of K3 surfaces can be calculated using modular forms.

title: Pandharipande-Thomas Conjecture
description: Stable pair and Donaldson-Thomas invariants are equivalent for Calabi-Yau threefolds.

title: Daw-Ren Conjecture
description: Provides necessary conditions for special subvarieties in the Zilber-Pink conjecture framework.

title: Vojta Conjecture
description: Heights of algebraic points on varieties are bounded by canonical classes.

title: Abhyankar Conjecture
description: Classifies finite groups appearing as Galois groups of affine curves.

title: Grothendieck P-Curvature Conjecture
description: Linear differential equations have algebraic solutions if their p-curvatures vanish.

title: Bombieri-Lang Conjecture
description: Rational points on general type algebraic varieties are not Zariski dense.

title: Oort Conjecture
description: Cyclic groups of prime power order lift to characteristic zero.

title: Voisin Conjecture
description: Questions whether compact Kahler manifolds are birationally equivalent to projective varieties.

title: Stolz Conjecture
description: Suggests a relationship between positive scalar curvature and the vanishing Witten genus.

title: Seshadri Constant Conjecture
description: Provides a universal lower bound for Seshadri constants of ample line bundles.

title: Cartan-Hadamard Conjecture
description: The isoperimetric inequality holds in simply connected spaces with non-positive curvature.

title: Filling Area Conjecture
description: The minimal area needed to bound a Riemannian circle is a hemisphere.

title: Cheeger-Gromoll Soul Conjecture
description: Complete open positively curved manifolds have souls diffeomorphic to a point.

title: Monodromy Conjecture
description: Relates poles of the local Igusa zeta function to eigenvalues of monodromy.

title: Zariski's Multiplicity Conjecture
description: Hypothesizes that topological types of hypersurface singularities completely determine their algebraic multiplicities.

title: Durfee Conjecture
description: Proposes an upper bound for the geometric signature of isolated surface singularities.

title: Coolidge Conjecture
description: Plane curves are rectifiable by Cremona transformations under specific rational geometric conditions.

title: Mather-Yau Theorem
description: Determines that isolated complex hypersurface singularities are characterized by their Tjurina algebras.

title: Zaidenberg's Conjecture
description: Conjectures that contractible affine surfaces without boundary are isomorphic to affine space.

title: Halperin-Carlsson Conjecture
description: Bounds the sum of Betti numbers for spaces admitting free torus actions.

title: Bott Conjecture
description: Posits that simply connected manifolds with positive sectional curvature are rationally elliptic.

title: Slope Conjecture for Moduli of Curves
description: Predicts the exact effective cone boundaries for the moduli space of curves.

title: Alexandrov's Soap Bubble Theorem
description: Proves embedded surfaces with constant mean curvature in Euclidean space are spheres.

title: Arakelov's Adjunction Formula Conjecture
description: Generalizes classical intersection adjunction formulas to heights in arithmetic Arakelov geometry.

title: Donaldson-Thomas Positivity Conjecture
description: Generalized Donaldson Thomas invariants for stable objects are always non negative integers.

title: Oka-Grauert Principle
description: Classifies holomorphic vector bundles on Stein manifolds according to their topological classifications.

title: Nadel Vanishing Theorem
description: Provides vanishing conditions for higher cohomology groups involving twisted multiplier ideal sheaves.

title: Lelong's Conjecture
description: States that positive closed currents with regular constant densities are integration currents.

title: Siu's Invariance of Plurigenera
description: Proves plurigenera remain invariant under smooth deformations of complex projective algebraic manifolds.

title: Kollar's Conjecture on Local Fundamental Groups
description: Questions the finiteness properties of local algebraic fundamental groups of singularity links.

title: Bloch's Conjecture on Zero Cycles
description: Suggests the vanishing of geometric genus implies a trivial Chow group.

title: L-space Conjecture
description: Relates Heegaard Floer homology to the existence of orderable fundamental groups.
